name: Direction Change
justification: Neat zigzag insight with a short formula; -1 edge case for 1xK adds a small trap.
solution_sketch: WLOG n<=m. Zigzag the diagonal in (n-1)+(m-1) moves; each extra 2 columns beyond the diagonal cost 2 wasted moves, so add 2*floor((m-n)/2). Special-case n=1: answer 0/1/-1 for m=1/2/>2.
